'''Aerospace group commander''' was a title that could be held by individuals aboard [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]]. [[Gareth Agamar]] held the position while serving about the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Mercurial]]''.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
